notes.title: Trading Cards are Available NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30645921/3c8c0ae76e9a27c3f77c7fa572f791584cd417cc.png[/img]
[h3]Hey there Guys!
I'm happy to announce the Trading Cards are finally Available for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/713530/ARMORED_KITTEN/]ARMORED KITTEN[/url] Players![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30645921/eee0468af76f9050a70d9337002b99d52535a4c6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30645921/b899ab719b53dd665af32c6c33947049656a1fe4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30645921/ce4c35848e847db1b4dc2c13038113df2ad1582b.png[/img]
[h3]All this cool stuff is only because of your support!
Thank you very much![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30645921/dfbd4b81a150b5577e4e9841672c22258d4df35e.png[/img]
[h3]Please share your thoughts about new trading cards, badges, emoticons and BGs in the comments![/h3]
[h1]THE [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1026880/FIREGROUND/]FIREGROUND[/url] GIVEAWAY IS CLOSED![/h1]
[h3]Stay healthy and have fun![/h3]
